info.name: BetSphere API — 0.1
info.description:
Phase 3 API. Import this collection and run the folders in order with the application and seeded data running. base_url uses HTTPS on port 443. Included credentials belong to the public demo accounts. Tokens and IDs are saved in collection variables. Postman manages the RefreshToken cookie automatically; refresh uses the most recent login session.

Write requests use demo_* IDs captured from records created by this collection. Each run creates and deletes test data. Set the repository root as the Postman working directory or select a file in Body > form-data > file before sending the four upload requests. The example file is the catalog football PNG. After a partial run, finish the Cleanup folder using the captured IDs.

The demo server uses a self-signed certificate. Configure certificate trust in your client before sending requests. Keep tokens local and clear them before exporting the collection.
